instructions: agent-desktop reads native accessibility trees and operates desktop apps. Each tool runs the agent-desktop CLI command of the same name and returns its JSON envelope: ok with data, or ok false with error; a call rejected before the command runs returns plain text. Read desktop_skills_get with name "desktop" first for the observe-act loop, and with name "platform" for what differs on this OS. The skills use CLI syntax: `agent-desktop snapshot --app Finder` is desktop_snapshot with {"app": "Finder"}, and the input schema replaces --help. Global flags (--session, --agent-id, --headed, --wait-for, --trace) are fixed by how this server was started and cannot be passed per call. Refs such as @s8f3k2p9:e1 come from desktop_snapshot and go stale when the UI changes: on STALE_REF or AMBIGUOUS_TARGET, snapshot again. Repeat an action only when its disposition.retry is "safe".
